description:
Runs OIDC discovery against the provider with the effective settings, or with the issuer URL, client ID and client secret sent in the body (not saved). Fields set by environment variables always use the environment value. A failed test still answers 200, with ok false and the reason in message.

Needs: a signed-in session (API tokens are refused). Administrators only

issuer_url.description: Issuer URL (https), empty uses the saved value

client_id.description: Client ID, empty uses the saved value

client_secret.description: Client secret, empty uses the saved value

200.description: The test result: ok, then the issuer and its authorization endpoint, or message when ok is false

message.description: Why the test failed; only when ok is false

403.description: Not allowed: API tokens are refused here, use a signed-in session. The answer is an error with the message `API tokens cannot be used for this request`.
